senses.gloss: f. (preced.) uncircumcision, the condition of one not circumcised.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 71a:18">Yeb. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ שלא בזמנה הויא ע׳</he> want of circumcision on account of untimeliness (the infant before its eighth day) creates the legal condition of the uncircumcised (with regard to the Passover meal, T’rumah &c.).
<cite ref="Yevamot 70b:12">Ib. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ דגופיה</he> one’s own want of circumcision; <he>ע׳ דאחריני</he> omission to circumcise others.
<cite ref="Chullin 4b">Ḥull. 4ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>מומר לע׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M00525"><he>מוּמָר</he></cite>; a. e.
